title: Complete Standard full-book source and frozen opportunity inventory
question: Can the authenticated whole Grinstead–Snell book produce one organized native source with complete page and annotation coverage?
method: Run the registered Standard producer with the original whole book and CPU in-page RapidOCR, then run M1 annotations on selected views. Interrupt the initial finalizer after diagnosing repeated native view loads in one sealed cut. Retry the exact sealed cut after reusing each view in the existing snapshot, and census native page membership, source projection and annotation status. Freeze a source-only sample before opening enrichment output.
commands: uv run ci run finalize 297 --output-realization nce-gs518-source-result:297 --json

outputs.role: Exact physical page, source view and annotation inventory
Active stack of the interrupted first finalization
Elapsed time and resident memory near interruption

conclusion: Run 297/cut 413 completes the Standard source and freezes its source-only benchmark. Its 518 pages share one organized native product. Full-book enrichment, independent quality assessment and the selected combined source have separate acceptance boundaries.
